profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PracticePanther Law Practice Management Software
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in WinForms, Unit Testing, C++, and HTML. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Applied Science (B.A.Sc.) focused in Computer Engineering from University of Miami.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer on multi-platform systems

*Mobile app development(iOS/Android) on the Xamarin.Form Framework.
* Front-End Angular 2/4/5 development.

positions.title: .Net Developer / Full stack software developer
positions.description:
Assisted in development of our POS software solutions in C#, under the WinForm framework.

Created, and maintained ASP.Net Web API 2 RESTful Api’s with dependency injection.

Responsible for creating responsive web base app, based on the AngularJs(up to 1.3x)

Created responsive HTML GUI  for angular/angular2 using bootstrap and Google Material library

Use GIT version control on all projects for source control. Used bitbucket to create pull request and review repositories.

Used twitter bootstrap framework to aide in the front-end development. 

Experience with CSS preprocessors such as SASS 

Collaborated with senior developers and project manager to design and plan new features for both our Web application and .Net Framework application.

Wrote and debug Jamsine unit test for our angular platform

Participated on troubleshooting and customer service ticket with customer support. 

Help the team on new responsive web application based on the angular 2 framework

projects.title: Resdroid: Human-Centric Cyber Intrusion Detection and Response system for smart- phones
projects.description: •	Develop a response system to protect sensitive information from rogue applications using the TaintDroid extension of the Android platform as well as a collaborative-filtering database of user responses based on the Slope One algorithm
